title: Asian Games: PH teen Prince Agustin narrowly misses teqball medal

blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Fourteen-year-old Prince Agustin came up short of a historic medal for the Philippines, losing to Myanmar’s Friday Saw, 12-7, 12-7, in the teqball men’s singles bronze medal match at the Asian Games 2026 on Sunday. Agustin battled the 36-year-old Southeast Asian Games bronze medalist, forcing a 7-7 tie in the second set before Saw’s experience prevailed at Nagoya City Higashi Sports Center. “I’m happy that I was able to show my best here at the Asian Games. This is the result of hard training,” Agustin said in Filipino. […]... Keep on reading: Asian Games: PH teen Prince Agustin narrowly misses teqball medal
